thread.title: Stock Market Mixed With Dow Leading; Palo Alto Networks Earnings Due

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Stock Market Mixed With Dow Leading; Palo Alto Networks Earnings Due
text:
The stock market was mixed early Thursday as the tech-heavy Nasdaq threatened to extend its losing streak to three trading sessions. The Nasdaq was again the laggard in early morning trade. Ollie's Bargain Outlet ( OLLI ) dipped after Wednesday's earnings release , while cybersecurity leaders Palo Alto Networks ( PANW ) and Okta ( OKTA ) will report after the stock market close. (For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today .)
X The Nasdaq composite fell 0.4%, while the S&P 500 dropped about 0.1%. The Dow Jones industrial average moved up 0.2%.
Among the Dow stocks , Apple ( AAPL ) fell for a second straight day, following up Wednesday's 0.7% fall with another 0.6% decline.
Among companies reporting earnings , Ollie's Bargain Outlet declined about 2% after the discount retailer reported strong Q2 results . The stock is extended from a flat base's 77.60 entry.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Recent IPO Zscaler ( ZS ) saw better-than-expected fiscal Q4 earnings , but shares fell 7%. Zscaler stock triggered the 7% to 8% loss-cutting sell signal from a 44.08 buy point after an Aug. 24 breakout.
IPO Leader DocuSign ( DOCU ) swung to a quarterly profit with earnings and sales beats. The stock dropped 7%, as a breakout above a cup with handle's 62.25 entry faltered and triggered a sell signal.
Reporting After The Stock Market Close After the stock market close, IBD 50 stock Palo Alto Networks will report its fiscal Q4 results. Analysts expect the company to earn $1.17 per share on revenue of $632 million. Shares are back in buy range above a flat base's 219.48 buy point, according to MarketSmith chart analysis.
Meanwhile, Okta is trading below a 61.10 entry ahead of its earnings results after the close. Consensus estimates show the company losing 20 cents per share on revenue of $85 million.
IBD 50 Stocks Among the top growth stocks , FANG stock Netflix ( NFLX ) looked to recover a portion of Wednesday's more than 6% fall, rising about 2% in early trade. Shares found resistance at their 50-day moving average line.
On the downside, Alarm.com ( ALRM ) plunged 10% after hitting a new high Wednesday. Meanwhile, Brooks Automation ( BRKS ) declined 4% but remains above a double bottom's 35.68 entry.
